full_period_m0_identity: For spatially homogeneous E_i00 and periodic full-period F_i21, the full-period integral of E_i00 dchi F_i21 is zero at each time by periodicity; this does not extend to spatial subintervals, spatially varying weights, local Ward or nonzero Fourier modes.
